cell_type.evidence: Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) is capable of enhancing the infiltration of immune cells into the tumour.

disease_state.evidence: keywords: Bacillus calmette-guérin; Bladder cancer; Human

material_type.evidence: inferred: This study involved a detailed examination of sequential samples collected before, during, and after BCG treatment to assess BCG's influence on the immune microenvironment, employing techniques such as immunohistochemistry, fluorescent multiplex immunohistochemistry, and mass spectrometry techniques.

sample_source.evidence: inferred: Ninety-six patients who underwent intravesical BCG therapy, comprising 46 responders and 50 non-responders, were retrospectively enroled to explore the evolving immune landscape.
